Rule: TTAT - average truck turnaround (report day)
Insight_If_Breached: Inbound trucks are waiting too long between check-in and dispatch
Recommended_Action: Check dock-door availability and receiving labour; prioritise trucks waiting longest

Rule: TTAT - worst single truck (report day)
Insight_If_Breached: At least one visit far exceeded the SLA
Recommended_Action: Investigate that visit - was the delay waiting (yard) or unloading (GR)?

Rule: Pallets/hr - site rate vs plan
Insight_If_Breached: Takeaway output is below the planned rate
Recommended_Action: Escalate to production - check downtime and manning

Rule: Line performance - production lines in alert
Insight_If_Breached: One or more production lines are DOWN / LOW OUTPUT / SURGE vs their own 14-day baseline
Recommended_Action: Walk the lines with the production supervisor; check the produced column of the Daily & Hourly Report

Rule: Shift attainment - current shift vs target
Insight_If_Breached: The running shift is behind its pro-rated target
Recommended_Action: Shift huddle - reallocate labour to the hours / flows flagged on the Daily & Hourly Report

Rule: Ramp-up attainment - day vs ramp-up plan
Insight_If_Breached: Site is behind the ramp-up curve for today
Recommended_Action: Report to hypercare; check projected end-of-day and required recovery rate

Rule: Trend deterioration - consecutive declining hours
Insight_If_Breached: Output has fallen for several hours in a row - early warning before a hard threshold trips
Recommended_Action: Check the hourly verdicts on the Daily & Hourly Report - line or space constraint?

Rule: Space constraint - free SHORT pallet spots
Insight_If_Breached: Short locations are almost full - takeaway will back up
Recommended_Action: Trigger bin-to-bin clean-up to release SHORT locations

Rule: Space constraint - Level A utilisation
Insight_If_Breached: Level A is congested - no put-away locations
Recommended_Action: Run relocation (move-up) to free Level A

Rule: Put-away backlog - pallets staged in HOFF IN
Insight_If_Breached: Inbound staging backlog upstream of Level A
Recommended_Action: Add put-away resource to clear HOFF IN staging

Rule: Inbound vs outbound balance (space direction of travel)
Insight_If_Breached: More pallets are coming in than going out - space will run out
Recommended_Action: Increase outbound picking or pre-clear locations before the next production wave

Rule: GR time - goods receipt duration (scan to close)
Insight_If_Breached: Unloading / scanning is slow
Recommended_Action: Add receiving labour or open another dock door

Rule: Production-to-storage 80/20 split
Insight_If_Breached: LTA output is not landing in Level A as designed
Recommended_Action: Deploy put-away resource immediately - this is usually the primary constraint

Rule: Outbound planning 80/20 split
Insight_If_Breached: Picks are not coming from Level A as designed
Recommended_Action: Re-point allocation to Level A stock; check why demand is sitting in non-A

Rule: Level A blocked by idle stock (bin-to-bin backlog)
Insight_If_Breached: Prime Level A slots are held by stock with no shipment demand
Recommended_Action: Work the bin-to-bin priority list (highest quantity first)

Rule: Outbound TAT - trailer loading time
Insight_If_Breached: Trailer loading is too slow
Recommended_Action: Check pick completion before loading and loader manning

Rule: Data integrity - health checks after refresh
Insight_If_Breached: Some data-health checks failed - alerts may be wrong
Recommended_Action: Open Config & Health and fix the FAIL rows before acting on any alert

Rule: Space constraint - free TALL pallet spots
Insight_If_Breached: Tall locations are almost full
Recommended_Action: Trigger bin-to-bin clean-up to release TALL locations

Rule: Storage location utilisation (all usable locations)
Insight_If_Breached: The warehouse is running out of usable storage locations
Recommended_Action: Review slow movers / blocked locations; plan overflow

Rule: Outbound truck turnaround (check-in to close)
Insight_If_Breached: Outbound trucks are on site too long
Recommended_Action: Check staging readiness and dock scheduling

Rule: User productivity - pallets per active user-hour
Insight_If_Breached: RF users are moving fewer pallets per hour than the standard
Recommended_Action: Review the User Productivity page - training / task interleaving / travel

Rule: Replica data freshness
Insight_If_Breached: The replica is behind the WMS - numbers are stale
Recommended_Action: Check HVR (data-replica-latency skill) before acting on alerts

Rule: Model refresh age
Insight_If_Breached: The semantic model has not refreshed recently
Recommended_Action: Check the scheduled refresh / gateway credentials in the Service

Rule: Take-away backlog - pallets queued in the line take-away lanes
Insight_If_Breached: Finished pallets wait at the line take-away lanes - put-away is behind production
Recommended_Action: Add forklift / put-away capacity at the take-away lanes and check free storage spots
